metadata.question: Does the northern Pacific Ocean at an eastern location (48.504441, -137.527803) exhibit a higher sea surface temperature anomaly during January 1-31, 2016, compared to a western location (46.750838, -169.318365)? The anomaly is calculated against the baseline average from 2003 to 2012.

1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use NOAA OISST V2.1 daily global SST: ImageCollection('NOAA/OISST/V2_1'). Fallback to V2 if needed.
- Period: 2016-01-01 to 2016-02-01 (inclusive of Jan 2016).
- Baseline: 2003-01-01 to 2013-01-01, filtered to January months.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- OISST is gap-filled, no cloud masking needed. Use the anomaly image’s mask to count valid pixels.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after filtering → C1.
- If anom image has 0 valid pixels at either location → C2.
- If computed anomaly is null/NaN/non-finite → C3.
- Else compare east > west → A else B.

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const eastPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-137.527803, 48.504441]); // (lon, lat)
    const westPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-169.318365, 46.750838]);

    const periodStart = '2016-01-01';
    const periodEnd = '2016-02-01'; // end-exclusive
    const baseStart = '2003-01-01';
    const baseEnd = '2013-01-01';

    // Helper to load OISST with fallback
    function getOISSTCollections(id) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(id).select('sst');
      const baseline = col
        .filterDate(baseStart, baseEnd)
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 1, 'month'));
      const period = col.filterDate(periodStart, periodEnd);
      return { id, baseline, period };
    }

    // Try primary and fallback datasets
    let candidates = ['NOAA/OISST/V2_1', 'NOAA/OISST/V2'];
    let chosen = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
      const c = getOISSTCollections(candidates[i]);
      let bCount = 0;
      let pCount = 0;
      try {
        bCount = c.baseline.size().getInfo();
        pCount = c.period.size().getInfo();
      } catch (e) {
        // Try next candidate
        continue;
      }
      if (bCount > 0 && pCount > 0) {
        chosen = { ...c, bCount, pCount };
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!chosen) {
      console.log('Baseline Jan images: 0; 2016 Jan images: 0');
      console.log('Dataset: None usable');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Dataset: ${chosen.id}`);
    console.log(`Baseline Jan images: ${chosen.bCount}; 2016 Jan images: ${chosen.pCount}`);

    // 3. Processing
    const baselineMean = chosen.baseline.mean(); // mean January (2003–2012)
    const periodMean = chosen.period.mean();     // mean Jan 2016
    const anomImg = periodMean.subtract(baselineMean).rename('anom'); // Kelvin/Celsius difference identical

    // Use a modest buffer and scale to aggregate
    const regionRadius = 25000; // 25 km
    const scale = 25000;

    // Count valid pixels after masking for anomaly
    const eastCount = ee.Number(
      anomImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: eastPt.buffer(regionRadius),
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('anom')
    ).getInfo();

    const westCount = ee.Number(
      anomImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: westPt.buffer(regionRadius),
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('anom')
    ).getInfo();

    if (!eastCount || !westCount || eastCount === 0 || westCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Valid pixels (east, west): ${eastCount || 0}, ${westCount || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const eastAnom = ee.Number(
      anomImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: eastPt.buffer(regionRadius),
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('anom')
    ).getInfo();

    const westAnom = ee.Number(
      anomImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: westPt.buffer(regionRadius),
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('anom')
    ).getInfo();

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const isValid = (v) => typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v);
    if (!isValid(eastAnom) || !isValid(westAnom)) {
      console.log(`East anom: ${eastAnom}, West anom: ${westAnom}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = eastAnom - westAnom;
    const fmt = (x) => (isFinite(x) ? x.toFixed(2) : String(x));

    console.log(`East anom (°C): ${fmt(eastAnom)}, pixels: ${eastCount}`);
    console.log(`West anom (°C): ${fmt(westAnom)}, pixels: ${westCount}`);
    console.log(`Diff (East - West) °C: ${fmt(diff)}`);

    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Handle any unexpected errors (dataset/band names, memory, etc.)
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}
```
